panels.title: Targets up
panels.description: Prometheus scrape health for the selected job. `up` is synthesised by Prometheus itself, not emitted by Moira.

panels.title: Request rate
panels.description: moira_http_requests_total — every HTTP request the service observed.

panels.title: 5xx ratio
panels.description: moira_http_response_status_class_total — 5xx responses as a fraction of all responses.

panels.title: HTTP p95
panels.description: moira_http_request_duration_seconds — 95th percentile across all routes.

panels.title: Redis coordination
panels.description: moira_redis_enabled — 1 when this process has Redis coordination enabled. Off by default.

panels.title: Workers
panels.description: moira_workers_enabled — 1 when background workers run in this process.

panels.title: Provider failure ratio
panels.description: moira_provider_outcome_total — attempts whose outcome is neither succeeded nor cancelled.

panels.title: Responses by status class
panels.description: moira_http_response_status_class_total. The label domain is 1xx/2xx/3xx/4xx/5xx/other.

panels.title: HTTP latency quantiles
panels.description: moira_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket. Buckets top out at 10s; anything slower lands in +Inf and the quantile is reported at the bucket edge.

panels.title: Top routes by request rate
panels.description: moira_http_request_duration_seconds_count. The `route` label is the matched Axum route template; unmatched requests are labelled `unmatched`.

panels.title: p95 latency by route (top 10)
panels.description: moira_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket, grouped by route template.

panels.title: Public API workload
panels.description: moira_public_responses_created_total and moira_public_streams_started_total.

panels.title: Mean HTTP latency (legacy counters)
panels.description: moira_http_latency_micros_total / moira_http_requests_total. Kept because the cumulative microsecond counter predates the histogram and is still exported.

panels.title: Execution outcomes
panels.description: moira_provider_outcome_total by outcome. Outcome values are `succeeded`, `cancelled`, `failed`, or one of the ExecutionFailureClass names.

panels.title: Failure ratio by provider type
panels.description: moira_provider_outcome_total. `provider_type` is the closed set openai, openai_compatible, anthropic, gemini, deepseek, azure_openai, local, custom.

panels.title: Execution latency p50/p95 by provider type
panels.description: moira_execution_duration_seconds_bucket. Buckets reach 120s, sized for provider round-trips.

panels.title: Time to first token p95
panels.description: moira_execution_ttft_seconds_bucket. Recorded only for streamed attempts, so this panel is empty on a deployment that never streams.

panels.title: Failed attempts by failure class (top 10)
panels.description: moira_provider_outcome_total. Failure classes carry no provider error text — the label is derived from the ExecutionFailureClass enum.

panels.title: Attempts by model key (top 10)
panels.description: moira_provider_outcome_total. `model_key` is admin-configured runtime config, so its cardinality is bounded by the operator's model catalogue.

panels.title: PostgreSQL pool occupancy
panels.description: moira_db_pool_connections{state="total"|"idle"}. Sampled once per scrape, not per request.

panels.title: Redis operation failures
panels.description: moira_redis_operation_failures_total by operation (rate_limit, permit_acquire, permit_release, publish, subscribe). Flat at zero when Redis is disabled, which is the default. Moira emits no Redis latency histogram today.

panels.title: Runtime-config invalidations by channel
panels.description: moira_runtime_invalidations_total. The `postgres` channel is authoritative; `redis` is an additive second signal present only when Redis is enabled.

panels.title: Retention sweeps and rows deleted
panels.description: moira_retention_runs_total and moira_retention_rows_deleted_total by table.

panels.title: Worker queue throughput
panels.description: moira_worker_jobs_claimed_total / _completed_total / _failed_total. `job_name` is the closed WORKER_JOB_NAMES set.

panels.title: Failed and dead-lettered jobs by name
panels.description: moira_worker_jobs_failed_total and moira_worker_jobs_dead_letter_total. A dead letter means max_attempts was exhausted.

panels.title: Queue back-pressure and supervisor ticks
panels.description: moira_worker_queue_enqueue_rejected_total (the pending-depth cap was hit) and moira_worker_ticks_total. Moira exports no queue-depth gauge today, so rejected enqueues are the saturation signal.

panels.title: Leader lock held
panels.description: moira_worker_leader_held. Per-process by construction; exactly one replica should hold each leader-gated job at a time.

panels.title: Ingestion and embedding volume
panels.description: moira_rag_ingestion_runs_total by outcome, moira_rag_chunks_written_total, moira_rag_embeddings_written_total. Embeddings stay at zero unless rag_embeddings_enabled is on.

panels.title: Vector-search and embedding latency p95
panels.description: moira_retrieval_latency_seconds_bucket (one retrieval pass: query embedding, both candidate queries, ranking) and moira_embedding_batch_latency_seconds_bucket (one document's whole run).

panels.title: Silent subsystems: run outcomes
panels.description: moira_retrieval_runs_total, moira_memory_extraction_runs_total and moira_summarization_runs_total. None of these surface a failure to the caller, so this panel is the only place a failing one shows up outside the database.

panels.title: Memory writes, rejections and inline reasoning
panels.description: moira_memory_extraction_written_total, moira_memory_extraction_rejected_total and moira_summarization_inline_reasoning_total. A non-zero inline-reasoning rate means the summarization backend is serving its chain of thought as ordinary text (finding F57).

panels.title: Admin invitation outcomes
panels.description: moira_admin_invite_outcomes_total. The label is a bounded outcome/denial-reason set — no invitee email, domain, invite id or issuer.

panels.title: Admin identity grant events
panels.description: moira_admin_identity_grant_events_total (granted, revoked, ownership_transferred). A grant carries full moira:admin.

title: Moira — service overview
description: Every panel queries a metric family emitted by src/infra/metrics.rs. The only exception is `up`, which Prometheus synthesises per scrape target. See deploy/observability/README.md.
